title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Upends Plans and Adds Costs for Marching Bands
summary: Nine marching bands were set to perform in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. The decision to move the event to Saturday posed new logistical challenges for them.
body_markdown: Nine marching bands were set to perform in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. The decision to move the event to Saturday posed new logistical challenges for them.
